Гимнема.about: Ayurvedic herb for diabetes. There are RCT (small samples), the effect on glycemia is modest - a decrease in HbA1c by 0.5-1%. Does not replace metformin.
Гимнема.caution: In type 2 diabetes - may increase the effect of metformin/insulin and the risk of hypoglycemia. Sugar monitoring is mandatory. Does not replace therapy. During pregnancy - avoid.
Гимнема.food_sources: It is not used as food - only the leaves of the plant in extract.
Гимнема.guidelines: In Ayurveda, it is a traditional remedy for diabetes. In India it is used as part of drugs. FDA/EFSA does not approve.
Гимнема.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for gymnemic acid 25%+. Check for COA.

interactions.note: risk of hypoglycemia - sugar control is mandatory

mechs: Gymnemic acid: blockade of sweet receptors on the tongue
Decreased perception of sweets and appetite for sugar
Gymnemosides: inhibition of intestinal glucose absorption
Гимнема.myths: “Treats diabetes” - no, only an auxiliary remedy. “Removes cravings for sweets completely” - the effect is moderate in some people.
Гимнема.name: Gymnema
Гимнема.onset: 2-4 weeks for effect on appetite; 8-12 weeks for changes in tests.
Гимнема.title: Gymnema
Гимнема.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 1 g/day are well tolerated.
Гимнема.who_needs: People with prediabetes (HbA1c 5.7-6.4%). For type 2 diabetes - only in addition to therapy, with control. To reduce cravings for sweets.
